## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION ↓ falling and SPY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -0.46%) RECOVERY ↑ rising vs TLT (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND — mixed confirmations support NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress RISING: HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.23%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND yet HYG/LQD ratio 1W: +0.19% signals tighter credit conditions. Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION ↓ falling; Stocks vs Bonds rising: SPY/TLT recovery.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP (Dollar) (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling while TLT (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and yield curve flat/above trend — conditions mixed but not restrictive.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy and Materials leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) and XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +10.51%); Tech ETF XLK in RECOVERY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: -2.60%) but Technology sector breadth is weak, and XLF (Financials) BELOW TREND (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -1.17%) — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US stocks RECOVERY: SPY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -0.46%) while Emerging Markets lead: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.69% | 1M: +6.25%) and Japan EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +10.18%); China FXI RECOVERY (1W: +3.14% | 1M: -2.88%) — global cyclicals outperforming select US exposures.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed speculative appetite: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +1.32%) shows small-cap bid while ARKK in RECOVERY (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -14.14%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -26.18%) show constrained crypto/theme risk.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Precious metals strong: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +10.75%) ↑ rising; industrial commodities mixed with CPER RECOVERY (1W: +1.41% | 1M: -0.22%) and copper/gold below trend.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leadership pronounced: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +10.63%) ↑ rising while natural gas UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -8.47% | 1M: +10.20%) — watch volatility divergence.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy XLE and Gold GLD ABOVE TREND on both timeframes. MINOR divergence: SPY and XLK are in RECOVERY (1W positive, 1M negative) and several thematic/crypto ETFs (ARKK, IBIT) are lagging — monitor for wider momentum pickup before committing big style shifts.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclical/resource exposures and safe-haven gold: XLE, XLB, GLD showing strength; reduce exposure to highly speculative crypto/theme ETFs such as IBIT and ETHA while bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND) remain a viable ballast.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +18.64%) and Materials XLB (1W: +3.33% | 1M: +10.51%) showing strength. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY (sector breadth negative) and Financials XLF (1W: -1.03% | 1M: -1.17%) showing weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Gold GLD (1W: +3.01% | 1M: +10.75%) and Brent BNO (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +10.63%). BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -8.47% | 1M: +10.20%) given short-term correction risk; silver SLV (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -0.87%) also under pressure.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold) vs current VXX (1W: -1.92% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health) with HYG (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +0.23%) and LQD (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +0.54%) ABOVE TREND; XLK/XLF pivot ~2.0 for Tech vs Financials rotation; IBIT downside risk if below recent lows.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive supporting a selective market, with mixed risk-cycle signals. Energy and Materials showing relative strength while Tech and Consumer Discretionary show weakness; key divergence to monitor is SPY and XLK in RECOVERY (week positive, month negative).
